Aaron Tshibola.note: Tshibola's edge is using strength without slowing the next action. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Aaron Tshibola.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Aaron Wan-Bissaka.note: Wan-Bissaka stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Aaron Wan-Bissaka.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Arthur Masuaku.note: Masuaku stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Arthur Masuaku.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Axel Tuanzebe.note: Tuanzebe is defined by recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Axel Tuanzebe.noteZh: 他靠第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Brian Cipenga.note: Cipenga's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Brian Cipenga.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Cedric Bakambu.note: Bakambu stands out for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Cedric Bakambu.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Chancel Mbemba.note: Mbemba is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Chancel Mbemba.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Charles Pickel.note: Watch Pickel for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Charles Pickel.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Dylan Batubinsika.note: Batubinsika stands out for using strength without slowing the next action. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Dylan Batubinsika.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Edo Kayembe.note: Kayembe stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Edo Kayembe.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Fiston Mayele.note: Mayele is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Fiston Mayele.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Gael Kakuta.note: Kakuta stands out for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Gael Kakuta.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Gedeon Kalulu.note: Watch Kalulu for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Gedeon Kalulu.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是防线暴露后的回追速度。留意他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Joris Kayembe.note: Kayembe's signature is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Joris Kayembe.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择上。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Lionel Mpasi.note: Mpasi stands out for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Lionel Mpasi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在危险出现前组织好队友。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Matthieu Epolo.note: Epolo's signature is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Matthieu Epolo.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在提前站位后的快速反应上。他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Meschack Elia.note: Elia is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Meschack Elia.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Nathanael Mbuku.note: Mbuku stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Nathanael Mbuku.noteZh: 他的突出特点是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Ngalayel Mukau.note: Mukau's edge is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Ngalayel Mukau.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Noah Sadiki.note: Sadiki's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Noah Sadiki.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定上。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Samuel Moutoussamy.note: Moutoussamy's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Samuel Moutoussamy.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Simon Banza.note: Banza's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Simon Banza.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Steve Kapuadi.note: Kapuadi's edge is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Steve Kapuadi.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Theo Bongonda.note: Bongonda's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Theo Bongonda.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Timothy Fayulu.note: Fayulu's signature is staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Timothy Fayulu.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注上。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Yoane Wissa.note: Wissa's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Yoane Wissa.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。
